subject.issue: charger missing from a delivered laptop box

references.title: Missing-item policy
attributes: no proof of purchase required within 30 days

facts: Missing accessories are replaced, not refunded.
Replacement dispatch takes 2 working days from confirmation.
Agents may confirm a missing accessory without a returns inspection.

subject.issue: refund not received three weeks after returning a monitor

references.title: Refund policy
attributes: processed within 5 to 10 working days of warehouse receipt
partial refund where packaging is missing

facts: Refunds are processed 5 to 10 working days after the warehouse logs the return.
The warehouse has not yet logged this return.
Returns are tracked under the original order reference.

subject.issue: charged twice for one annual subscription

references.title: Billing policy
attributes: duplicate charges reversed within 3 to 5 working days
reversal goes to the original payment method

facts: Duplicate charges are reversed within 3 to 5 working days.
The reversal returns to the original payment method and cannot be redirected.
Agents can trigger the reversal without manager approval.

subject.issue: delivery marked as arrived but nothing was received

references.title: Non-delivery policy
attributes: carrier investigation takes up to 7 working days
replacement or refund once the investigation closes

facts: A carrier investigation must close before a replacement is authorised.
Carrier investigations take up to 7 working days.
The customer chooses replacement or refund once it closes.

subject.issue: locked out after a password reset loop

references.title: Account recovery policy
attributes: identity check by email plus one further factor

facts: Manual unlock happens within 1 working day of a completed identity check.
The identity check needs email confirmation plus one further factor.
Agents cannot bypass the identity check.

subject.issue: keyboard stopped responding six weeks after purchase

references.title: Warranty policy
attributes: repair or replace at the company's discretion
return postage paid by the company

facts: The warranty runs 12 months from delivery.
The company chooses between repair and replacement.
Return postage is paid by the company.

subject.issue: wants to cancel mid-term after a price rise

references.title: Mid-term cancellation policy
attributes: no cash refund on annual plans

facts: Annual plans give a pro-rata credit, not a cash refund.
Credit is applied within 10 working days.
Introduced with the March pricing change.

subject.issue: wants a courier redelivery outside the standard window

facts: One redelivery per order is free.
Weekend slots are not offered by the carrier.
A second redelivery costs 6.50 and agents cannot waive it.
